snippet.title: THE MAGICIAN VR: THE CURSED WAND - RELEASE WINDOW - The UploadVR Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Puzzles of the World is now live for pre-order! Get a 33% discount ahead of our full game release on July 23rd with 7 amazing levels from across the world.Puzzles of the World is a virtual reality game that combines the relaxing nature of building miniature wooden puzzles, with beautiful environments from around the world and beyond.
